summary: Acquire is a classic tile-laying and stock investment game where players place tiles to grow hotel chains on a shared board and buy stock in those chains hoping they merge profitably. The tension comes from timing: buying into a small chain before it merges into a larger one, and deciding whether to hold or sell shares right as a merger is about to pay out big bonuses.
praised: simple rules hiding surprisingly deep investment strategy
classic, enduring design that still holds up
tense merger moments with real money swings
criticised: can be swingy based on tile luck late game
runaway leader potential if one player dominates early mergers
some player-elimination-adjacent frustration when a chain you invested in never grows

interaction.kind: stock investment and market manipulation on a shared board
interaction.detail: All chains and the tile grid are fully shared and public, so a tile placement that merges two hotel chains directly determines bonus payouts and share values for every player holding stock in those chains.

scoring.why: Tile placement and mergers only matter because they build chains whose stock you hold, and the game is decided purely by converting all assets to cash at the end.
scoring.how_you_win: You win by having the most cash after all stock is sold for its final value when the game ends.
